deadline.value: Application deadline for full consideration for fall admission is February 1.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for full consideration for fall admission is February 1

gre_general.value: The program no longer requires GRE General scores; you may still send them in supplemental documents.
gre_general.quote: We no longer require verbal, quantitative, or analytical GRE scores. | However, if you wish to supply these scores, you may supply them as part of your supplemental documentation

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is not required.
gre_subject.quote: We also do not require the Physics GRE

toefl_min.value: Department minimum total TOEFL iBT score of 80 (internet-based) for graduate admission.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum total TOEFL scores for graduate admission into the MU Physics program are 550 (paper-based), 213 (computer-based) or 80 (internet-based)

ielts_min.value: Department accepts IELTS with a minimum of 6.5 (or Duolingo 115) as an alternative to TOEFL.
ielts_min.quote: The IELTS test with a minimum score of 6.5 or Duolingo with a minimum score of 115 are acceptable alternatives to TOEFL

supervisor.value: The department page does not state whether an adviser must agree before admission.

funding.value: Incoming students are usually assigned as teaching assistants, and all regular TAs and RAs receive a full university tuition waiver.
funding.quote: Incoming students are usually assigned as teaching assistants (TA) | all regular teaching and research assistants are granted a full tuition waiver by the University

entry_route.value: Students with a four-year physics or closely related bachelor's can apply directly; those with a three-year degree need an MS or one more year.
entry_route.quote: We welcome applications from students who have successfully completed a 4-year undergraduate degree in physics or closely related fields | International students who have gone through a 3-year undergraduate degree program need to have an MS degree or one additional year after their bachelor's to become eligible for admission

notes: Department page: Fall deadline February 1, Spring October 1. Supervisor rule not stated on the department or Graduate School pages.
